## Verdict

missing

## Bearer

PasteResultScreen — app-phone/src/main/java/com/mgilli/hyroxtracker/ui/pasteresult/PasteResultScreen.kt

## Trigger

Pasting text into the pastedText TextField, in PasteResultScreen — observed

## Today

The pastedText TextField carries no height constraint and no scroll of
its own; the enclosing Column carries no scroll modifier either. When
the pasted text runs to thirty rows the TextField grows to fit it,
pushing the "Importer" Text (the action element, bound to
viewModel::onImportClicked) below the bottom of the screen, where it
is not shown and cannot be tapped.

## Expected

The pastedText TextField keeps a fixed height and scrolls its own
content once the pasted text exceeds it, so the layout below it —
the race name field, the date, and the "Importer" action — keeps a
fixed position on screen and stays reachable regardless of how many
rows are pasted.
